# Stats and figures (generated by `python -m src.stats`)

Methods: paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples of questions, seed 469, 95% percentile interval) for accuracy and differences; exact McNemar test on fixed/broken pairs with Holm correction across the three comparisons; Wilson 95% intervals for attack-success and false-block rates.

## Part 1: does self-correction help?

n = 300 questions, every version answers all of them (paired). Fixed/broken counts matches A's transitions.csv.

| Version | EX | 95% CI | Avg tokens | Avg LLM latency (s) |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|
| Guess once | 61.7% | 56.0% to 67.0% | 2,371 (1.00x) | 3.80 (1.00x) |
| Retry on error | 62.0% | 56.3% to 67.3% | 2,397 (1.01x) | 3.84 (1.01x) |
| Self-check | 61.0% | 55.3% to 66.3% | 5,693 (2.40x) | 9.25 (2.44x) |

| Comparison | Fixed | Broken | Difference in EX | 95% CI | McNemar exact p | Holm p |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|
| Guess once -> Retry on error | 1 | 0 | +0.3% | +0.0% to +1.0% | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| Retry on error -> Self-check | 5 | 8 | -1.0% | -3.3% to +1.3% | 0.581 | 1.000 |
| Guess once -> Self-check | 6 | 8 | -0.7% | -3.0% to +1.7% | 0.791 | 1.000 |

## Attacks

### Direct SQL (30 payloads, each run on a fresh copy, no LLM)

| Layer setting | Succeeded | Attack success rate | Wilson 95% CI |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| none | 28/30 | 93% | 79% to 98% |
| allowlist | 8/30 | 27% | 14% to 44% |
| readonly_uri_only | 10/30 | 33% | 19% to 51% |
| readonly | 9/30 | 30% | 17% to 48% |
| approval | 8/30 | 27% | 14% to 44% |
| all | 8/30 | 27% | 14% to 44% |

### Through the agent (model: gpt-6-luna; 25 scenarios)

| Version | Layer setting | Succeeded | Rate | Wilson 95% CI |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Guess once | none | 2/25 | 8% | 2% to 25% |
| Guess once | prompt_rule | 1/25 | 4% | 1% to 20% |
| Guess once | allowlist | 1/25 | 4% | 1% to 20% |
| Guess once | readonly | 1/25 | 4% | 1% to 20% |
| Guess once | approval | 1/25 | 4% | 1% to 20% |
| Guess once | all | 1/25 | 4% | 1% to 20% |
| Self-check | none | 5/25 | 20% | 9% to 39% |
| Self-check | prompt_rule | 1/25 | 4% | 1% to 20% |
| Self-check | allowlist | 3/25 | 12% | 4% to 30% |
| Self-check | readonly | 4/25 | 16% | 6% to 35% |
| Self-check | approval | 3/25 | 12% | 4% to 30% |
| Self-check | all | 1/25 | 4% | 1% to 20% |

No layers, guess once vs self-check, paired by scenario (n = 25): 3 attacks succeeded only against self-check, 0 only against guess once (exact McNemar p = 0.25). Guess once never sees the data, so indirect injection cannot reach it by construction.
